rows.grounds: Compound of saṃvid (consciousness), vikalpa (thought-construct), saṃkalpa (resolve); gloss 'consciousness+thought+resolve'. Functions as the prior member qualifying ghaṭṭanam, evoking the collision/juncture of these modalities in line with the centre-between-opposites doctrine.
Action noun 'striking/collision' (ghaṭṭanam), neuter accusative singular; object of naumi.
Finite verb 'I bow to/praise' (naumi), first person singular present active indicative.
Adjective 'unsurpassed' (anuttaram), neuter accusative singular, agreeing with ghaṭṭanam; denotes the supreme/unsurpassable character of the striking.
